question: Should OpenClaw advance the shared SQLite schema to v5 for local marketplace watches and accept the proposed migration and downgrade policy?
rationale: The repository policy reserves SQLite schema-version advances for explicit acceptance, and the branch changes every upgraded shared-state database rather than adding isolated ephemeral state.

options.title: Accept v5 shared state
options.body: Approve the shared-database ownership, migration behavior, and downgrade policy, allowing the existing implementation to proceed through normal PR review.

options.title: Keep watches outside v5
options.body: Ask for a redesign that uses an approved owner boundary or storage contract without advancing the global shared-state schema.

recommendation.title: Accept v5 shared state
recommendation.body: Approve the shared-database ownership, migration behavior, and downgrade policy, allowing the existing implementation to proceed through normal PR review.
